blocks.text: ESTATE CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Estate Cleanout in Schomberg

items.q: How much does an estate cleanout cost in Schomberg?
a: Pricing is based on how many rooms and structures are involved — never on the village or its distance from any particular city. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Do you charge extra for rural properties or hamlet homes?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at Main Street, in Lloydtown, Pottageville or Kettleby, and on a farm well out on the concessions.

items.q: Can you coordinate directly with an executor or realtor?
a: Yes — timelines and documentation can be confirmed directly with whoever’s managing the estate or the sale.

items.q: Can the cleanout include a barn or outbuilding, not just the house?
a: Yes — it’s regular work for us on the township’s farm properties, all under one flat, honest price.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the family is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.

items.q: Can family members who live elsewhere stay updated without being present?
a: Yes. Photo updates and progress reports are available throughout, so family coordinating from a distance can stay informed without needing to be on site.

items.q: Is there a deadline required, or can this happen on our own timeline?
a: Either works. Some estate cleanouts are tied to a closing or a listing date; others happen whenever the family is ready. Both get the same flat pricing and the same care.
